parsed.why: No criminalisation and mixed-positive public opinion, but a 2026 police raid extorting and falsely charging LGBTQ detainees plus post-election persecution, with no hate-crime or discrimination remedy and courts refusing gender recognition.

No trans criminalisation, but government crackdowns on visible LGBTQ expression backed by religious leaders, deep social hostility (69% criminalise view, 5% back trans legal change), zero discrimination protection and only dated enforcement incidents.

Progressive gender-recognition law, X markers, affirmed-gender custody and courts overturning a care ban outweigh a record hate-crime year, abolished equality agency and activist-reported deterioration; no visitor-facing restriction documented.

Documented derisive border treatment of a trans traveller, pervasive censorship of gender-nonconforming expression, no protections or registration, gated care — yet no criminalisation, no arrest pattern, and one assault ending in guard dismissals.

Appearance-based arrests under a real imprisonment statute, routine police extortion, a 2023 morals unit, and transgender women held in male prisons facing sexual violence; hostile society and no recognition or remedy.
